Hisense US 75E7SF / E7 series (100, 85, 75, 65, 55, 50 in), E8 and QD4 (43QD40R, 40QD40R, 32QD40HR) and the S6 RoamView 32 in: the sitemap title for 75E7SF says 85 class, the E7/E8 category cards show no model numbers, and QD4 shows no resolution, so none is listed.

UK: uk.hisense.com, Currys and Argos returned HTTP 403, so UK offers are John Lewis only (38 models, 2025 and 2026 lines); Hisense UK models John Lewis does not stock (for example other E6Q sizes, any A-series or Laser TV) were not confirmed.

UK (TUK-code) models are kept as separate products from US models of the same series (for example 65U7STUK and 65U7SG) because no page read confirms they are the same hardware and their smart OS differs; regionalModels therefore holds only same-code regional listings (uk, ca, mx).

Ireland: Harvey Norman IE returned HTTP 403, Euronics.ie and DID.ie render their product grids with scripts so no Hisense TV listing could be read, the Kean's (keanscm.ie) 55E71Q page returned only site navigation, and no Hisense Ireland site was found, so no ie offer is recorded.

Canada: Best Buy CA returned HTTP 403, Walmart.ca a robot check and a Leon's product page HTTP 404; the only ca offers are 6 read on The Brick's own pages, and hisense-canada.com lists 38 series with sizes but no prices or per-size model numbers, so its other series (UR8SG, U7SG, QD8SF, U68SG/SF, E7SF, QD6SF etc.) are not listed for Canada.

Mexico: hisense.com.mx returned HTTP 503 and Liverpool HTTP 403, and Coppel and Walmart MX were not read, so mx offers are Cyberpuerta only; its Hisense category reports 82 products over 4 pages but the page text yielded only 41 of them.

Cyberpuerta entries without a full model number were left out: 'LED H5 Series 55 in' (5,749 MXN), 'LED Class H5 Series 50 in' (5,109 MXN), 'QLED QD6 65 in' (12,989 MXN), 'Mini LED U65QFM 55 in' (10,009 MXN) and 'LED A6NV 58 in' (7,279 MXN); a second QD7N 100 in listing at 38,409 MXN was dropped in favour of the explicit 100QD7N at 32,549 MXN.
Where a retailer showed a reduced price, the regular ('reduced from' / was) price is recorded; The Brick and Cyberpuerta show a single price with no regular price, so that single figure is recorded.

onModeWatts: only four products have a figure, all from the John Lewis spec line 'Power consumption (on mode)' in W (43E7STUK PRO 50.0, 55Q7STUK 63.0, 65U7STUK 84.0, 65UR8STUK 80.0), which the page does not label SDR; the energy data of the other 103 products was not read within the fetch budget.

onModeWatts for 32S5QTUK: the John Lewis page gives only 26 kWh (SDR) and 40 kWh (HDR) per 1000 hours and no on-mode watts, so it stays null rather than being derived; The Brick's 65UR9SG row reads 'Energy Consumption 280' with no unit or on-mode label, so it is not recorded; two ENERGY STAR open-data queries for brand Hisense returned zero rows.
EPREL numbers: no page read showed an EPREL registration number or eprel.ec.europa.eu link, so eprel is null throughout.

Richard and Cyberpuerta print none), except 2026 on the SG-code UR8, UR9 and U7 models, taken from Best Buy's product titles for those series and The Brick's '2026 Model' on 65UR9SG; smart OS and refresh rate are null wherever the page read did not state them.
